response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong DLang, TypeScript, and infrastructure exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role, particularly the 8 years of C++ programming experience (he has roughly 1.5 years of C/C++ at National Instruments plus a bachelor thesis project) and there is no evidence of cloud compute platform leadership, large-scale distributed systems ownership, or formal technical leadership/mentoring at the scale described.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing, mentoring via workshops/talks)
Long tenure of senior-level roles and self-driven open-source platform (GISCollective) showing initiative and ownership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~1.5 years) versus the required 8 years
No demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform, distributed systems, or hardware architecture experience
No evidence of formal technical leadership role managing teams, priorities, or cross-team alignment at the scope required

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud/compute infrastructure leadership experience
Strong general engineering craftsmanship and mentoring exposure
